# Nonprofit Wizard
An educational program of Benny Labs Foundation Inc., a 501(c)(3) public charity.
Free nonprofit startup education and free consultations. Optional document-preparation assistance is separate and may carry charges. No government affiliation or approval guarantee.

## Learning resources
- https://nonprofitwizard.org/article-before-you-start.html
- https://nonprofitwizard.org/nonprofit-roadmap.html
- https://nonprofitwizard.org/board-and-bylaws.html
- https://nonprofitwizard.org/startup-checklist.html
- https://nonprofitwizard.org/apply-for-ein-yourself.html (self-service education only; official IRS process is free)
- https://nonprofitwizard.org/ongoing-responsibilities.html
- https://nonprofitwizard.org/articles.html

Consultations: https://nonprofitwizard.org/#contact
